blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – Police anti-narcotics operatives seized P1,451,121 worth of shabu (crystal meth) from an alleged “high-value” drug trafficker in Calamba City, Laguna on Tuesday. A 38-year-old man was detained for selling P500 worth of shabu to an undercover police officer in Barangay Pansol at 6:15 p.m., said Lt. Col. Dennis de Guzman, Calamba City police chief, in a report. The drug enforcers confiscated from the suspect eight heat-sealed plastic sachets and one transparent plastic containing suspected shabu weighing a total of 213.4 grams.
